vulnerabilities_fixed.title: API Keys Stored as Plain Strings
vulnerabilities_fixed.description: API keys were stored as plain String types, making them susceptible to memory dumps and crash report exposure.
vulnerabilities_fixed.fix: Replaced plain String with SecureString (~Copyable, Sendable) using XOR obfuscation and zero-on-deinit memory protection
vulnerabilities_fixed.verification: SecureString uses ~Copyable (Swift 6.2), XOR obfuscation (0xA5 key), and zeroes buffer in deinit

vulnerabilities_fixed.title: URL String Interpolation Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities_fixed.description: URLs were constructed using string interpolation or concatenation, enabling path traversal attacks like '../etc/passwd'.
vulnerabilities_fixed.fix: Implemented SecureURLConstruction using URLComponents with path validation. All URL construction now uses Result<URL, Error> pattern instead of force unwraps.
vulnerabilities_fixed.verification: SecureURLConstruction.build() validates paths using containsPathTraversal() before construction

vulnerabilities_fixed.title: Missing Path Traversal Protection
vulnerabilities_fixed.description: No validation existed for path components, allowing directory traversal attacks through malicious input.
vulnerabilities_fixed.fix: Added comprehensive path traversal detection and sanitization. All path components are validated for '../' and '..' sequences.
vulnerabilities_fixed.verification: Tests confirm rejection of paths containing '../', '..', and traversal sequences in pollURL and modelDownloadURL

vulnerabilities_fixed.title: Missing Domain Whitelist Validation
vulnerabilities_fixed.description: No validation of target domains for external URLs, potentially allowing requests to malicious domains.
vulnerabilities_fixed.fix: Added isInAllowedDomain() validation with domain whitelists. Model downloads restricted to huggingface.co domains.
vulnerabilities_fixed.verification: modelDownloadURL validates host contains 'huggingface.co' before returning URL

vulnerabilities_fixed.title: Force Unwraps in URL Construction
vulnerabilities_fixed.description: Force unwraps (!) used for URL construction could cause crashes on invalid input.
vulnerabilities_fixed.fix: Replaced all force unwraps with Result<URL, Error> pattern and proper error propagation.
vulnerabilities_fixed.verification: secureElevenLabsURL now returns Result<URL, SecureURLConstruction.Error> instead of URL?

vulnerabilities_fixed.title: API Keys Exposed in Closures
vulnerabilities_fixed.description: API keys were passed as plain strings through multiple closure boundaries.
vulnerabilities_fixed.fix: Implemented withSecureAccess pattern - API key is only decrypted temporarily within the closure scope.
vulnerabilities_fixed.verification: All API key usage now wrapped in withSecureAccess { key in ... } blocks
